name: Hornet
overview: Scripture reveals that God used hornets, or wasps, as instruments of His judgment and deliverance, driving out enemy nations such as the Hivite, Canaanite, and Amorite without the direct use of human weapons. In Exodus 23:28 and Joshua 24:12, the hornet is depicted as a divine agent sent before Israel to displace their adversaries, emphasizing God's sovereign power in battle. Deuteronomy 7:20 further underscores this by showing that God would send hornets to destroy those who sought to hide from Israel, demonstrating His thorough and just protection of His people.
